    CERTIFICATE. Excellence: 50 Excellence credits. Merit: 50 at Merit OR
    Excellence, so Excellence credits count towards Merit. With 50 credits
    but no certificate, *_endorsement_credits_met is true and
    *_endorsement_earned is false: say it is awarded once the level is.

    COURSE ENDORSEMENT IS 14 CREDITS IN ONE COURSE: Excellence at Excellence,
    Merit at Merit or above, Achieved at any grade.

    UE (LEVEL 3 ONLY): NCEA Level 3, three approved subjects each with 14+
    credits, literacy of 5 reading AND 5 writing (not 10 in total), and 10
    numeracy credits. Say which requirement is missing.

    Not checked: the level of each standard, and the 3 internal and 3
    external credits a course endorsement needs in most courses. New
    qualifications replace NCEA from 2028 and are not modelled. For a rank
    score, use nz_ncea_rank_score_calculator.

    Args:
        level: 1, 2 or 3.
        subjects: List of {"name", "achieved", "merit", "excellence",
            "ue_approved"}; credits that count towards the 60, whole numbers;
            ue_approved is for Level 3 subjects on NZQA's approved list.
        ue_literacy_reading_credits: Level 3: Level 2+ reading credits on the UE list.
        ue_literacy_writing_credits: Level 3: Level 2+ writing credits on the UE list.
        ue_numeracy_credits: Level 3: UE numeracy credits.
        literacy_corequisite_credits: literacy co-requisite credits (need 10).
        numeracy_corequisite_credits: numeracy co-requisite credits (need 10).

    Returns:
        Totals by grade, whether the 60 and the co-requisite are met, whether
        the level is achieved and what is missing, both certificate
        endorsements with credits still needed, each course endorsement, and
        University Entrance at Level 3.

tools.name: nz_public_holidays_calculator
tools.description:
List New Zealand public holidays for a year, count them, and find the next one.

    Use for: 'public holidays nz 2027', 'when is the next public holiday nz',
    'how many public holidays in nz', 'is waitangi day mondayised', 'when is
    matariki 2028', 'auckland anniversary day', 'nz stat holidays'.

    THE COUNT IS NOT ALWAYS ELEVEN. Ten before Matariki began in 2022, twelve
    in 2022 with the one-off Queen Elizabeth II Memorial Day, eleven since, plus
    one for a region's anniversary day.

    MONDAYISATION MOVES THE DAY OFF, NOT THE HOLIDAY. For someone who does not
    work that weekend day, Christmas, Boxing Day, 1 and 2 January move from a
    Saturday to the Monday and from a Sunday to the TUESDAY (so a Sunday
    Christmas is Tuesday 27 and Boxing Day Monday 26). Waitangi Day and Anzac
    Day move to the Monday, and only from 2014. Each holiday carries both actual_date and date (the
    day off), with mondayised set when they differ.

    TWO HOLIDAYS CAN SHARE A DAY. Anzac Day fell on Easter Monday in 2011 and is
    Mondayised onto it in 2038. distinct_days_off counts the day once.

    MATARIKI is gazetted, not calculated, and is listed only from 2022. The
    gazetted dates run to 2052, which is the last year this covers.

    REGIONAL ANNIVERSARY DAYS are given on the day OBSERVED, which is rarely
    the anniversary: usually the Monday nearest it (Auckland 29 January was
    observed Monday 26 January 2026), but Taranaki is the second Monday in
    March, Southland Easter Tuesday, Canterbury Show Day Friday in November,
    South Canterbury the fourth Monday in September, Hawke's Bay the Friday
    before Labour Day and Marlborough the Monday after (Employment New
    Zealand). Each regional entry carries actual_date (the anniversary) and
    date (the day off). Available from 2010.

    Args:
        year: Calendar year, 2000 to 2052. Defaults to the year of after, or
            the current year.
        region: Optional anniversary region key, for example auckland,
            wellington, canterbury, otago. Omit for national holidays only.
        after: Optional ISO date. Returns the next holiday strictly after it.

    Returns:
        Every holiday with its actual and observed date, the national,
        regional and distinct day counts, and the next holiday when asked.

tools.name: nz_business_days_calculator
tools.description:
Count New Zealand working days between two dates, or add or subtract N working days.

    Use for: 'working days between two dates nz', '10 working days from today
    nz', 'business days calculator nz', 'how many working days until
    christmas', '20 working days notice', 'subtract working days from a date'.

    THE END DATE IS COUNTED, THE START DATE IS NOT, unless include_start is
    true. Monday to Friday of one week is 4 business days by default.

    ADD AND SUBTRACT start from the next (or previous) day, so one business day
    after a Friday is the Monday.

    HOLIDAYS COME OUT ON THEIR OBSERVED DATES. A Saturday Anzac Day removes the
    Monday after it; Christmas and Boxing Day on a weekend remove the Monday and
    Tuesday. Waitangi Day and Anzac Day were only Mondayised from 2014, and
    Matariki exists only from 2022. A holiday on the weekend itself counts as a
    weekend day.

    A REGIONAL ANNIVERSARY DAY is excluded only when region is given, on the
    day it is OBSERVED that year, by Employment New Zealand's rules: usually
    the Monday nearest the anniversary (Auckland 29 Jan observed Monday 26
    January 2026), with exceptions such as Southland on Easter Tuesday and
    Canterbury on Show Day Friday in November. Available from 2010.

    Statutes often define working days with their own extra exclusions, such
    as 25 December to 15 January. This does not apply those.

    Args:
        start_date: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD.
        end_date: ISO date, for mode between. Counted.
        mode: between, add or subtract.
        days: Business days to add or subtract, at least 1.
        include_start: Whether the start date itself counts. Default False.
        region: Optional anniversary region key, for example auckland,
            wellington, canterbury.

    Returns:
        Business, calendar, weekend and holiday counts, the holidays met, the
        target date for add or subtract, and weeks and days.

tools.name: nz_holiday_pay_calculator
tools.description:
Work out New Zealand holiday pay: annual leave, 8% pay as you go, public
    holidays, or the leave payout on termination.

    Use for: 'how is holiday pay calculated NZ', 'holiday pay calculator',
    'average weekly earnings vs ordinary weekly pay', '8% holiday pay casual',
    'pay as you go holiday pay', 'do I get time and a half on a public holiday',
    'alternative holiday day in lieu', 'holiday pay when I leave my job'.

    PICK THE MODE. Each has one rule that is regularly got wrong.

    annual_leave: leave is paid at the GREATER of ordinary weekly pay and
    average weekly earnings (1/52 of the gross earnings for the 12 months
    before the last pay period before the holiday). Someone whose overtime or
    commission lifts their average above their base is owed the average.

    pay_as_you_go: 8% of gross pay BEFORE the loading. $1,200 earns $96, so the
    pay is $1,296; 8% of $1,296 is the wrong base. Lawful only for a fixed term
    under twelve months or genuinely intermittent or irregular work, written
    into the agreement and an identifiable part of each pay. payg_allowed says
    whether it is; the loading is shown either way. Pass pay_periods_per_year
    (26 fortnightly, 12 monthly) for the annual figure.

    public_holiday: worked, at least time and a half for the hours, PLUS an
    alternative holiday (a paid day off later) if it was an otherwise working
    day. Time and a half is on everything they would have been paid for those
    hours; hourly_rate is taken as that. A day the employee would not
    otherwise have worked earns the time and a half only. Not worked on an
    otherwise working day: relevant daily pay (hourly_rate x normal_hours), or
    average daily pay (daily_pay_method="average" with
    days_worked_last_52_weeks) where relevant daily pay cannot practicably be
    worked out or varies. Alternative holidays do not expire; after 12 months
    the employee may ask to exchange one for payment.

    termination: ask whether they worked there 12 months. Over 12 months, the
    untaken ENTITLEMENT from completed years (untaken_weeks: not a payslip
    balance that includes leave accruing since the anniversary) at the
    greater of the two weekly rates, plus 8% of gross earnings since the last
    anniversary, less holiday_pay_already_paid; those earnings INCLUDE the
    leave paid out and any public holidays (public_holidays_in_leave_period,
    s40) and alternative holidays (alternative_holidays_owed) paid out, and
    earnings_since_anniversary should include final wages, notice pay and
    any bonus or commission. Under 12 months, service="under12": 8% of the
    earnings since they started. Same code as nz_final_pay_calculator, so the
    two agree.

    This is the Holidays Act 2003, which applies until the Employment Leave Act
    2026 commences on 6 August 2028 (State school board staff on the education
    payroll: by Order in Council, no later than 6 August 2036). All figures are
    gross. Rules from the Act and Employment New Zealand.

    Args:
        mode: annual_leave, pay_as_you_go, public_holiday or termination.
        ordinary_weekly_pay: What a normal week earns.
        gross_earnings_last_52_weeks: 12 months of gross earnings, for AWE and
            average daily pay.
        leave_weeks: Weeks of leave taken (annual_leave).
        gross_pay_period: Gross pay before the 8% loading (pay_as_you_go).
        employment_type: casual-genuine, casual-doubtful, fixed-term-under,
            fixed-term-over or permanent (pay_as_you_go).
        in_agreement: 8% PAYG is in the written agreement.
        payslip_identified: The 8% is an identifiable part of the pay.
        pay_periods_per_year: Pay periods a year for the annual figure.
        worked: The public holiday was worked.
        otherwise_working_day: The day would otherwise have been worked.
        hours_worked: Hours worked on the public holiday.
        hourly_rate: Ordinary hourly rate.
        normal_hours: Hours they would have worked that day.
        multiplier: Public holiday rate, at least 1.5.
        public_holiday_days: Public holidays not worked.
        daily_pay_method: auto, relevant or average.
        days_worked_last_52_weeks: Days worked or on paid leave, for average
            daily pay.
        service: over12 or under12 (termination).
        untaken_weeks: Untaken entitlement from completed years, in weeks
            (termination).
        earnings_since_anniversary: Earnings since the last anniversary,
            including final wages (termination).
        public_holidays_in_leave_period: s40 public holidays (termination).
        alternative_holidays_owed: Alternative holidays not taken
            (termination).
        holiday_pay_already_paid: Holiday pay already paid in advance or as
            pay as you go (termination).

    Returns:
        total_gross for the mode, the working spelled out, the OWP and AWE
        comparison where it applies, PAYG eligibility, the daily rate and its
        basis, the alternative holiday, and the termination split.

tools.name: nz_rates_water_calculator
tools.description:
Estimate a New Zealand house's 2026/27 council rates and water charges.

    Use for: 'how much are rates on a $700k house', 'council rates calculator
    nz', 'auckland rates estimate', 'christchurch rates and water', 'what are
    water rates in wellington', 'rates per week nz'.

    ONLY NINE COUNCILS, each for a standard house in the area stated:
    Auckland (Watercare-metered house), Wellington City, Christchurch City,
    Hamilton City, Tauranga City, Dunedin City, Selwyn (Rolleston),
    Waimakariri (Rangiora) and Queenstown Lakes (Queenstown). Any other council
    or town (Kaiapoi, Wanaka, Upper Hutt, Nelson...) returns an error: tell the
    user to use that council's own rates search. Never substitute another
    council's figures.

    FIGURES ARE EACH COUNCIL'S ADOPTED 2026/27 RATES, GST inclusive, with the
    water organisation's 2026/27 prices where it bills water (Watercare, Tiaki
    Wai, IAWAI, Selwyn Water). Usage matters only in Auckland, Tauranga,
    Selwyn, and Christchurch above 900 litres a day (each part of a m3 charged
    as a whole one). A usage of 0 is 0; null is the 170 m3 starting figure.
    For Waimakariri pass land_value, or its urban drainage rate is left out
    (land_value_rate_left_out says so).

    Outside Auckland (a unitary council) regional council rates are NOT
    included. Every answer carries source_url, rating_year and not_included.

    Args:
        capital_value: The property's capital value in dollars.
        council: A council key or name from the page.
        water_usage_m3: Annual water use in cubic metres. Default 170.
        land_value: The property's land value; used only for Waimakariri.

    Returns:
        General rate, UAGC, water, wastewater, stormwater, rubbish, other
        targeted rates, the total yearly, quarterly, monthly and weekly, rates
        as a share of CV, who bills water, the 2026/27 rebate figures, the
        rating year and the council's source.

tools.name: nz_import_duty_calculator
tools.description:
Estimate customs duty, GST and the Customs and MPI goods levy on goods sent or shipped to New Zealand.

    Use for: 'import duty calculator nz', 'how much gst on imports nz',
    'customs charges on a shipment', 'landed cost nz', 'do I pay duty on
    goods from overseas', 'customs goods levy', 'is there duty under $1000'.

    $1,000 OR LESS, CUSTOMS COLLECTS NOTHING (NZ Customs Service): no duty,
    GST or levy unless the item or shipment is valued over NZ$1,000. The
    international freight to New Zealand is NOT part of that value. An
    overseas supplier may already have charged GST at checkout. Same-supplier
    orders arriving the same day count as one shipment. Alcohol and tobacco
    are charged whatever their value and are not covered by this tool.

    NOT FOR LUGGAGE: goods in a traveller's baggage fall under the $700
    traveller allowance and carry neither goods levy. Say so if asked.

    Over $1,000: duty is on the goods value only, not the freight. GST is
    charged on the goods, the freight and insurance, AND the duty. $1,500 of
    goods with $150 freight at 5% duty is $75 duty and $258.75 GST.

    The goods levy (from 1 April 2026, excluding GST) is $51.81 by air or
    post ($7.24 Customs + $44.57 MPI) and $118.44 by sea ($73.87 + $44.57);
    GST is added. By air the example pays $393.33 to Customs. A broker will
    also charge for their services.

    GIFTS are charged like other goods here; Customs sources disagree on a
    gift over $1,000 (see not_modelled), so tell the user to confirm.

    Values are in NZD; there is no currency conversion.

    Args:
        goods_value: Customs value of the goods in NZD, excluding freight.
        freight_insurance: International freight and insurance in NZD.
        duty_rate_percent: Duty rate as a percentage, e.g. 5.
        transport: 'air', 'post' (air rate) or 'sea'. Default 'air'.
        levy_excl_gst: Override the goods levy, NZD excl GST. Omit for the register.

    Returns:
        Whether Customs collects, duty, the GST base, GST, the levy with its
        GST, the total payable to Customs, the landed cost, the sources and
        what is not modelled.

tools.name: nz_super_rates_calculator
tools.description:
Look up the New Zealand Superannuation (NZ Super, the pension) rate for 2026.

    Use for: 'nz super rates 2026', 'how much is nz super', 'pension rates nz',
    'nz superannuation fortnightly', 'super for a couple', 'super rate single
    living alone', 'how much super after tax'.

    WORK AND INCOME PUBLISHES NZ SUPER FORTNIGHTLY, before tax and after tax at
    two codes: M when Super is the main income, S when it sits beside a job.
    These are the figures returned. Weekly and yearly are derived from the
    fortnightly one (halved, and times 26) and the notes say so.

    A COUPLE'S RATE IS PUBLISHED EACH AND COMBINED. Use couple_both_qualify_each
    for one person; the combined figure is the couple's total and is often misread
    as one person's pension.

    For another secondary code (SH, ST, SA), take fortnightly_before_tax to the
    nz_secondary_tax tool: Work and Income does not publish those.

    Args:
        living_situation: single_living_alone, single_sharing,
            couple_both_qualify_each, couple_both_qualify_combined,
            couple_one_qualifies, couple_partner_included_each,
            couple_partner_included_combined or hospital.
        tax_code: "M" if Super is the main income, "S" if it is secondary.

    Returns:
        Fortnightly before and after tax as published, weekly and yearly derived,
        the tax per fortnight, the date the rates apply from and their source.

tools.name: nz_cpi_inflation_calculator
tools.description:
What an amount of money in one quarter is worth in another, by the NZ CPI.

    Use for: 'what is $100 in 1990 worth today NZ', 'cpi nz', 'inflation since 2000
    nz', 'cpi adjustment 2026', 'adjust for inflation nz', 'how much has inflation
    gone up', 'value of money in 1970'.

    USES THE OFFICIAL STATS NZ CPI, not an assumed inflation rate: series
    CPIQ.SE9A, All groups for New Zealand, from 1914, the same series the site's
    inflation calculator reads. value = amount x CPI(to) / CPI(from).

    OMIT to_year FOR TODAY: the latest published quarter is used and named in
    latest_quarter. Before 1926 Stats NZ published one or two quarters a year; a
    quarter it did not publish is refused, with the ones it did.

    Args:
        amount: Dollars in the earlier quarter.
        from_year: Year of the earlier quarter.
        from_quarter: March, June, September or December (or 3, 6, 9, 12).
            Omitted, the year's last published quarter.
        to_year: Year to convert to. Omitted, the latest quarter.
        to_quarter: Quarter to convert to, as for from_quarter.

    Returns:
        The converted value, the total change, the average yearly change and the
        two CPI index numbers used.

tools.name: nz_depreciation_rate_finder
tools.description:
Find Inland Revenue's depreciation rate for an asset in New Zealand.

    Use for: 'ird depreciation rate finder', 'depreciation rate for a laptop nz',
    'what is the depreciation rate on a car', 'ird depreciation rates 2026',
    'depreciation rate for rental chattels', 'heat pump depreciation rate'.

    RETURNS IRD'S OWN RATES from IR265 General depreciation rates (March 2026):
    estimated useful life, diminishing value (DV) and straight line (SL) rate,
    for each asset that matches, best match first.

    Buildings with a useful life of 50 years or more are 0%. An asset costing
    $1,000 or less can usually be expensed in full instead. To turn a rate into
    year-by-year deductions, pass it to the depreciation_calculator tool.

    Args:
        query: The asset, for example laptop, heat pump, ute, carpet.
        limit: The most matches to return, 1 to 50.

    Returns:
        Matching assets with IRD's useful life, DV and SL rates and the source.

tools.name: nz_school_terms_calculator
tools.description:
NZ school term dates and school holidays, and when the next holidays are.

    Use for: 'school holidays nz 2026', 'school holidays 2027', 'nz school term
    dates 2027', 'when do school holidays start', 'term 1 2027 start date',
    'school holidays 2028 nz', 'how long are the summer holidays'.

    FROM THE MINISTRY OF EDUCATION, for 2026, 2027 and 2028. Terms 2 and 3 are
    fixed nationwide, so the autumn, winter and spring holidays are exact for
    every state school. THE SUMMER HOLIDAYS ARE A WINDOW: Term 4 ends no later
    than a set Friday and Term 1 starts between two dates, each school choosing
    within them, so the summer break is returned as that window.

    Pass as_at (YYYY-MM-DD, the New Zealand date) to get the next holidays from
    that day, and whether they are already underway.

    Args:
        year: The school year, 2026 to 2028. Omitted, the year of as_at.
        as_at: Date to find the next holidays from. Omitted, today.

    Returns:
        The four terms, every holiday break, the next break and the source.

tools.name: nz_gst_due_dates_calculator
tools.description:
When a New Zealand GST return and payment is due.

    Use for: 'gst due dates 2026', 'when is gst due', 'gst due date nz',
    'gst return due january', 'gst due 28th', 'six monthly gst due dates',
    'do I need to register for gst'.

    THE RULE: the 28th of the month after the taxable period ends, and payment
    is due the same day. TWO EXCEPTIONS: the period ending 30 November is due
    15 January, and the period ending 31 March is due 7 May. A due date on a
    weekend or national public holiday moves to the next working day.

    Give period_end (the period's last day) for one period, or a filing frequency
    and cycle_end_month for the next periods. Give annual_turnover to check the
    $60,000 registration threshold and the frequency limits ($500,000 for
    six-monthly, $24 million above which monthly is compulsory).

    Args:
        filing_frequency: monthly, two_monthly or six_monthly.
        period_end: A period's last day, YYYY-MM-DD.
        cycle_end_month: Any month (1 to 12) in which one of your periods ends.
        as_at: Date to list the next periods from. Omitted, today.
        count: How many upcoming periods to list, 1 to 12.
        annual_turnover: Optional 12-month turnover.

    Returns:
        Each period's dates and due date, and the turnover checks if asked.

tools.name: nz_esct_calculator
tools.description:
Employer superannuation contribution tax (ESCT) on a New Zealand employer's KiwiSaver contribution.

    Use for: 'esct rates', 'esct calculator', 'esct tax rates nz', 'how much

        The ESCT rate and band, and the contribution before and after ESCT,

tools.name: nz_kilometre_rate_calculator
tools.description:
A New Zealand vehicle expense claim at Inland Revenue's kilometre rates.

    Use for: 'ird mileage rate', 'ird km rate', 'mileage rate nz', 'ird

tools.name: nz_median_earnings_calculator
tools.description:
Median annual earnings in New Zealand, by region, age band or sex.

    Use for: 'median income nz', 'average salary nz', 'median salary nz 2024',
    'average income by age nz', 'median wage canterbury', 'what is a good

tools.name: nz_interest_rates_calculator
tools.description:
New Zealand's Official Cash Rate and the average six-month term deposit rate.

tools.name: nz_university_grade_scales
tools.description:
The grading scale at a New Zealand university.

    Use for: 'uc grading scale', 'uc grade scale', 'uoa gpa scale', 'vuw grades',
    'otago grade scale', 'what is a b+ at uni nz', 'massey grades'.

tools.name: air_pressure_at_altitude_calculator

Air pressure at an altitude, by the International Standard Atmosphere.

tools.name: shoe_size_converter
tools.description:
Converts a shoe size between NZ and UK, US, EU and foot length.

    'us 10 in nz', 'womens shoe size chart nz'.

        UK and NZ, US and EU sizes and foot length in centimetres.

tools.name: number_to_words_converter
tools.description:
Writes a number in words, New Zealand usage.

    NZ ENGLISH SAYS AND: 123 is one hundred and twenty-three, 1,005 is one

tools.name: cents_dollars_converter

        The amount in dollars and in cents.

tools.name: square_metres_calculator
tools.description:
Square metres from a length and width.

tools.name: right_angle_triangle_calculator
tools.description:
Solves a right-angle triangle.

    'find the hypotenuse', 'missing side of a triangle', 'triangle angle
    calculator'.

tools.name: cubic_metres_to_tonnes_converter
tools.description:
Converts cubic metres to tonnes for a material.

    Use for: 'cubic metres to tonnes', 'm3 to tonnes', 'how heavy is a cubic
    metre of gravel', 'concrete weight per m3', 'tonnes of topsoil'.

tools.name: nz_uomi_penalties_calculator
tools.description:
Use of money interest (UOMI) and late payment penalties on New Zealand tax paid late.

    Use for: 'ird use of money interest rate', 'uomi rate 2026', 'prescribed
    interest rate 2026', 'ird late payment penalty', 'how much interest does ird
    charge', 'ird interest on overdue tax'.

    RATES from 16 January 2026: 8.97% charged on underpaid tax, 2.25% paid on

tools.name: nz_student_loan_repayment_calculator

Student loan repayments for a New Zealand based borrower.

tools.name: nz_provisional_tax_dates_calculator
tools.description:
New Zealand provisional tax and terminal tax due dates.

    is provisional tax due', 'terminal tax date', 'ratio option dates'.

    31 MARCH BALANCE DATE: 28 August, 15 January and 7 May (standard or estimation);

tools.name: nz_life_expectancy_calculator
tools.description:
Life expectancy in New Zealand at any age, by sex and ethnic group.

    Use for: 'life expectancy nz', 'nz life expectancy', 'life expectancy new
    zealand', 'life expectancy at 65 nz', 'how long will I live nz', 'maori life
    expectancy'.

    Stats NZ 2022-2024: at birth 80.1 years for males and 83.5 for females. At 65,
    19.4 more years for men and 21.6 for women. Maori 73.7 and 78.0 at birth,
